throw a party: We are going to throw a party for Grandpa's eightieth birthday and invite all our relatives.
我們要為爺爺的八十歲生日辦派對，並邀請所有的親戚。
throw light on: The new study may throw light on why some teenagers have trouble falling asleep at night.
這項新研究或許能闡明為什麼有些青少年晚上難以入睡。
throw a tantrum: The little boy began to throw a tantrum in the supermarket when his mother refused to buy him candy.
媽媽拒絕買糖果給他時，那個小男孩開始在超市裡發脾氣。
throw in the towel: After failing the driving test five times, Tom almost wanted to throw in the towel, but he tried once more.
駕照考試考了五次都沒過後，湯姆幾乎想要認輸了，但他又試了一次。
throw caution to the wind: For once, Lisa decided to throw caution to the wind and spent all her savings on a trip around Europe.
這一次，麗莎決定不顧一切，把所有積蓄都花在環遊歐洲的旅行上。
throw doubt on: The new video from the street camera may throw doubt on the driver's story about the accident.
街頭監視器拍到的新影片可能會使人懷疑那位駕駛對車禍的說法。
throw away a chance: Don't throw away a chance to study abroad just because you are afraid of living alone.
不要只因為害怕一個人生活，就錯失出國讀書的機會。
throw one's weight around: The new manager likes to throw his weight around and shouts at workers who disagree with him.
那位新經理喜歡仗勢欺人，會對不同意他的員工大吼。
throw up: The bus ride along the mountain road was so bumpy that my little sister started to throw up.
沿著山路的公車行程太顛簸了，我妹妹開始嘔吐。
thrust into the spotlight: After her video went viral online, the shy high school girl was suddenly thrust into the spotlight.
她的影片在網路上爆紅後，那位害羞的高中女生突然被推上聚光燈下。
thrust upon someone: The job of taking care of the whole family was thrust upon him when his father became ill.
父親生病時，照顧全家的責任被強加在他身上。
thrust a document at: The angry customer walked in and thrust a document at the clerk, demanding to know why he was charged twice.
那位生氣的顧客走進來，把一份文件塞給店員，要求知道為什麼他被收了兩次錢。
the main thrust of: The main thrust of her speech was that schools should start later so that students can get more sleep.
她演講的主要重點是學校應該晚一點開始上課，好讓學生能多睡一點。
thrust forward: As soon as the gates opened, the excited fans thrust forward to get closer to the stage.
大門一打開，興奮的歌迷就向前推進，想要更靠近舞台。
thumb through a book: While waiting for my friend at the bookstore, I picked up a cookbook and began to thumb through it.
在書店等朋友時，我拿起一本食譜開始翻閱。
thumb a ride: When their car broke down on the country road, the two travelers had to thumb a ride to the nearest town.
他們的車在鄉間道路上拋錨時，那兩位旅人只好搭便車到最近的城鎮。
thumb one's nose at: The rich businessman seemed to thumb his nose at the rules and parked his car wherever he liked.
那位有錢的商人似乎藐視規定，想把車停哪裡就停哪裡。
under someone's thumb: Even after getting married, Jack still seems to be under his mother's thumb and asks her about every decision.
即使結婚後，傑克似乎仍受他媽媽控制，每個決定都要問她。
all thumbs: I tried to help my aunt wrap the gifts, but I was all thumbs and kept tearing the paper.
我試著幫阿姨包禮物，但我笨手笨腳的，一直把包裝紙撕破。
rule of thumb: A good rule of thumb is to drink a glass of water every time you feel hungry between meals.
一個好的經驗法則是，每次在兩餐之間感到飢餓時就喝一杯水。
tick the box: If you would like to receive our monthly newsletter by email, please tick the box at the bottom of the form.
如果你想透過電子郵件收到我們的每月電子報，請在表格最下方勾選。
tick off a list: Before leaving for camp, I like to tick off a list of things I need, such as a flashlight and a raincoat.
出發去露營前，我喜歡把需要的東西像是手電筒和雨衣逐項勾掉。
what makes someone tick: After reading the famous singer's diary, fans finally understood what makes her tick and why she works so hard.
讀了那位知名歌手的日記後，歌迷終於了解驅使她的動力是什麼，以及她為什麼那麼努力。
tick someone off: It really ticks me off when people talk loudly on their phones during a movie.
人們在看電影時大聲講電話真的惹惱我。
the clock is ticking: We still have three questions left and only five minutes, so hurry up because the clock is ticking.
我們還剩三題卻只有五分鐘，所以快一點，時間緊迫。
tick over: During the rainy season, the beach shop only manages to tick over until the summer visitors return.
雨季期間，那家海灘商店只能勉強維持，直到夏季遊客回來。
tickle one's fancy: If none of these desserts tickle your fancy, the waiter can bring you some fresh fruit instead.
如果這些甜點沒有一樣引起你的興趣，服務生可以改送一些新鮮水果給你。
be tickled pink: My little sister was tickled pink when her favorite singer waved at her during the concert.
我妹妹最喜歡的歌手在演唱會上向她揮手時，她樂壞了。
tickle the taste buds: The sweet and sour sauce on this fried fish will tickle the taste buds of anyone who tries it.
這道炸魚上的糖醋醬會刺激每個品嚐者的味蕾。
tickle one's funny bone: The comedian's silly jokes about school life really tickle my funny bone every time I watch his show.
每次我看那位喜劇演員的節目，他關於學校生活的搞笑笑話都真的逗得我發笑。
